purpose: Define machine-readable recursive introspection/help for runtime symbol roots and namespace families so users and tools can enumerate what a namespace means without a duplicated hand-maintained help tree.

topics.name: Namespace Introspection and Help
topics.purpose: Define machine-readable recursive introspection/help for runtime symbol roots and namespace families so users and tools can enumerate what a namespace means without a duplicated hand-maintained help tree.

semantics.introspection_rule: Each namespace root/family exposes identity, owner, type, short help and long help or refs to canonical help metadata.
semantics.enumeration_rule: A reader may recursively enumerate registered child namespaces/mounts according to visibility/authorization.
semantics.dynamic_rule: Dynamic families report declared family semantics separately from current runtime child instances.
semantics.help_rule: Help describes namespace semantics but never creates namespace membership or capability.
semantics.visibility_rule: Introspection obeys applicable access/metadata visibility policy.
semantics.source_rule: Help/introspection derives from the canonical namespace registry and owning contracts.
semantics.presentation_rule: CLI/web/tree representations are projections over the same registry.

invariants.rule: Runtime symbol namespaces, roots, mounts and dynamic families are explicit, collision-free and never inferred solely from filesystem layout or display labels.

hard_gates.condition: help tree diverges from namespace registry without reconciliation
help text creates namespace semantics absent from registry
dynamic runtime child mistaken for family definition

references.purpose: Namespace and command help follow common canonical metadata principles.
Introspection is derived from registry state.
